:::{#rem-expression-parse-tree}
#### Expressions, precedence and parse trees

An expression does not say how to compute the output it fixes,
and many expressions denote the same function.
A function is the input-output relationship itself;
an expression is one way of writing it down.

The rules of operator precedence (PEMDAS: parentheses, exponents,
multiplication and division, addition and subtraction)
decide how the symbols group.
They turn the string into its parse tree (@def-parse-tree).

:::
